propositions: 344 closed bugs lack a metrics lens to aggregate close_class distribution over time, detection channel, open-bug age, caused_by component fan-in, and time-to-close percentiles; trend questions currently require ad-hoc scripts.
Pre-convention bugs (~214) lack the close_class field; the lens must surface this era explicitly as a labeled MISSING cohort alongside vocabulary classes to prevent silent mixing of taxonomy eras.

The detected_by field is sparse (sibling feature still landing); the lens must degrade that dimension to unavailable without crashing or affecting other dimensions when detected_by is absent everywhere.

Flow dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) filter on close transition within the ctx range; stock dimensions (open-bug age percentiles, detected_by distribution, caused_by fan-in) are point-in-time measures ignoring the range.

The lens must follow the standard rebar metrics registry pattern (_spec() registration), integrate via side-effect import in __init__.py, and handle edge cases (zero bugs → unavailable state, single-sample percentiles, in_progress counted as open).
